author: deployedmind
text:
Should a general AI model memorize every known protein structure? 

Isomorphic Labs CEO Demis Hassabis says probably not: overspecialization can weaken broader capabilities. His alternative is expert scientific models coordinated by a general agent.

author: deployedmind
text: Demis Hassabis says AI could compress drug discovery from a process that takes 10+ years and billions of dollars to months, and perhaps, one day, weeks, opening the door to tackling hundreds of diseases over the next decade.
